roadmap.title: Learn the standard run
roadmap.description: Reach Antes 4 and 8, win a run, form the basic poker-hand achievements, and begin the persistent play and discard counters.

roadmap.title: Clear deliberate single-run setups
roadmap.description: Build the money, Voucher, speed, no-reroll, card-modifier, deck-size, and high-score conditions on suitable standard runs.

roadmap.title: Advance stakes and challenges
roadmap.description: Climb one deck through Red, Black, and Gold Stake, unlock Challenge Mode with five deck wins, then complete all 20 Challenge Decks.

roadmap.title: Complete the collection
roadmap.description: Discover every Tarot, Planet, Spectral, Voucher, Joker, deck, pack, tag, edition, and Boss Blind entry without using the achievement-disabling Unlock All option.

roadmap.title: Finish Gold Stake mastery
roadmap.description: Win Gold Stake with all 15 decks, carry every Joker through a Gold Stake win, and perform the required encore wins after both final completion conditions.

achievements.description: Reach Ante 4
achievements.summary: Advance a standard run to @mechanic{Ante 4} by defeating the Ante 3 Boss Blind.

guide.context: Challenge Decks disable ordinary achievements, so use any standard deck and stake for this progression milestone.

steps.text: Start a run with any standard deck on an available stake.
Defeat the Small Blind, Big Blind, and Boss Blind as needed through Ante 3.
Leave the Ante 3 Boss shop and advance until the run displays Ante 4.

achievements.description: Reach Ante 8
achievements.summary: Advance a standard run to @mechanic{Ante 8} by defeating the Ante 7 Boss Blind.

guide.context: Reaching Ante 8 is the final approach to a normal win; the run is won only after the Ante 8 Boss Blind is defeated.

steps.text: Start a standard run and build enough Chips and Mult to clear each rising Blind requirement.
Defeat the Ante 7 Boss Blind and continue from its shop.
Advance until the run display changes to Ante 8.

achievements.description: Win a Run
achievements.summary: Win a standard run by defeating the @mechanic{Ante 8 Boss Blind}.

guide.context: The achievement can register at the win screen or after another run starts, rather than at the exact moment the final score is reached.

steps.text: Reach Ante 8 with a standard deck and a scoring build capable of meeting the final Blind requirement.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind before running out of hands.
Proceed to the You Win screen and start another run if the achievement notification is delayed.

achievements.description: Win a run on at least Red Stake difficulty
achievements.summary: Win a standard run on @mechanic{Red Stake} difficulty or any higher stake.

guide.context: Stake progression is tracked separately for each deck, and a deck unlocks its next stake only by winning its highest available stake.

steps.text: Win White Stake with one standard deck to unlock Red Stake for that same deck.
Start that deck on Red Stake or a higher unlocked stake.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind and reach the You Win screen.

achievements.description: Win a run on at least Black Stake difficulty
achievements.summary: Win a standard run on @mechanic{Black Stake} difficulty or any higher stake.

guide.context: Each higher stake includes all modifiers from the lower stakes, so continue the same deck's stake ladder rather than switching decks.

steps.text: Win the successive available stakes with one standard deck until Black Stake is unlocked for that deck.
Start the prepared deck on Black Stake or a higher unlocked stake.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind and reach the You Win screen.

achievements.description: Win a run on at least Gold Stake difficulty
achievements.summary: Win a standard run on @mechanic{Gold Stake}, Balatro's eighth stake difficulty.

guide.context: Gold Stake is unlocked per deck after wins on the seven preceding stakes and adds every earlier stake modifier.

steps.text: With one standard deck, win each available stake in sequence until Gold Stake unlocks for that deck.
Select that deck, choose Gold Stake, and begin the run.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind and reach the You Win screen on Gold Stake.

achievements.description: Play at least 2500 Cards
achievements.summary: Play a cumulative total of 2,500 playing cards across standard runs on the same profile.

guide.context: This counter persists across the entire profile rather than requiring 2,500 cards in one run.

steps.text: Play normal poker hands in standard runs, selecting up to five playing cards each time.
Continue playing cards across later runs until the cumulative total reaches 2,500.

achievements.description: Discard at least 2500 Cards
achievements.summary: Discard a cumulative total of 2,500 playing cards across standard runs on the same profile.

guide.context: The achievement counts discarded cards across the profile, so selecting several cards per discard advances it faster than single-card discards.

steps.text: Use the Discard command on as many unwanted playing cards as the current hand and discard allowance permit.
Keep discarding cards across standard runs until the cumulative total reaches 2,500.

achievements.description: Have $400 or more during a single run
achievements.summary: Raise the money display to at least @mechanic{$400} during one standard run.

guide.context: The $400 must be held simultaneously; money earned and later spent does not count toward the requirement.

steps.text: Use Blind rewards, interest, economy Jokers, and money-generating cards to build a stable income.
Preserve the scoring pieces needed to survive, then stop unnecessary shop purchases and rerolls.
Continue the run until the money display reaches $400 or more at one time.

achievements.description: Play a Flush with 5 Wild Cards
achievements.summary: Play a normal @mechanic{Flush} made from five @item{Wild Cards} in one scoring hand.

guide.context: Four Wild Cards work when Four Fingers is active, but Flush House and Flush Five hands do not satisfy this achievement.

steps.text: Use copies of the @item{The Lovers} Tarot card to enhance five playing cards into Wild Cards.
Manipulate and discard the hand until five Wild Cards are held together.
Select the five Wild Cards, confirm that the hand preview reads Flush, and play the hand.

achievements.description: Win a run in 12 or fewer rounds
achievements.summary: Win a standard eight-Ante run after playing no more than 12 Blind rounds.

guide.context: A standard run offers 24 Blinds across eight Antes, so this route requires skipping at least 12 Small or Big Blinds while still defeating every Boss Blind.

steps.text: Choose a standard deck and build scoring power that can survive with fewer shop visits and Blind rewards.
Use Skip Blind on at least 12 Small or Big Blinds while tracking the rounds played.
Defeat every required Boss Blind, including the Ante 8 Boss, before the played-round count exceeds 12.

achievements.description: Buy 5 Vouchers by the end of Ante 4
achievements.summary: Purchase five @item{Vouchers} before leaving Ante 4 in one standard run.

guide.context: A normal run supplies one Voucher per Ante; an extra purchase can come from a Voucher Tag or from Hieroglyph or Petroglyph lowering the Ante. Vouchers granted by a starting deck do not count.

steps.text: Buy the offered Voucher during each early Ante whenever funds permit.
Claim a Voucher Tag by skipping its Blind, or buy Hieroglyph or Petroglyph to create another Voucher opportunity before Ante 4 ends.
Buy the fifth counted Voucher while the run is still in Ante 4 or earlier.

achievements.description: Break 2 Glass Cards in a single hand
achievements.summary: Make two @item{Glass Cards} shatter after scoring in the same played hand.

guide.context: Each Glass Card supplies X2 Mult and has a 1-in-4 chance to be destroyed after scoring, so both cards must pass that destruction roll on one hand.

steps.text: Use @item{Justice} Tarot cards to enhance at least two playing cards into Glass Cards.
Draw two Glass Cards together and select a poker hand in which both cards will score.
Play the hand and repeat the setup in later hands or runs until two Glass Cards shatter after the same scoring sequence.

achievements.description: Play a Royal Flush
achievements.summary: Play a @mechanic{Royal Flush}: Ace, King, Queen, Jack, and 10 from the same suit.

guide.context: A Royal Flush is evaluated as a Straight Flush whose five ranks are all 10 or higher, and card selection order does not matter.

steps.text: Choose one suit and preserve its Ace, King, Queen, Jack, and 10 while discarding unrelated cards.
Draw all five required ranks from the chosen suit into the same hand.
Select the five cards, confirm the hand preview reads Royal Flush, and play them.

achievements.description: Get any poker hand to level 10
achievements.summary: Raise any single poker hand type from level 1 to @mechanic{level 10} during one run.

guide.context: Poker-hand levels reset each run; matching Planet cards raise their hand by one level, while Black Hole raises every hand by one.

steps.text: Choose a frequently played poker hand and identify its matching Planet card in Run Info.
Open Celestial Packs and shops, then use repeated copies of that Planet card or Black Hole.
Open Run Info and continue upgrading until the chosen poker hand displays level 10.

achievements.description: Score 10,000 Chips in a single hand
achievements.summary: Score at least 10,000 Chips with one played poker hand.

guide.context: The threshold uses the final Chips multiplied by Mult for a single hand, not the total score accumulated across a Blind.

steps.text: Combine Chip-producing Jokers, additive Mult, multiplicative Mult, card enhancements, and hand levels.
Play the build's strongest poker hand and finish its scoring sequence at 10,000 Chips or more.

achievements.description: Score 1,000,000 Chips in a single hand
achievements.summary: Score at least 1,000,000 Chips with one played poker hand.

guide.context: Multiplicative Mult effects apply after additive Mult and are the main scaling layer needed beyond early-game score thresholds.

steps.text: Level a reliable poker hand and build a Joker lineup with Chips, additive Mult, and multiple X Mult effects.
Add useful enhancements, editions, and seals to the playing cards used by the scoring hand.
Play the optimized hand and finish its scoring sequence at 1,000,000 Chips or more.

achievements.description: Score 100,000,000 Chips in a single hand
achievements.summary: Score at least 100,000,000 Chips with one played poker hand.

guide.context: This threshold requires exponential scaling from several compatible X Mult or retrigger effects rather than a large Blind total spread across hands.

steps.text: Assemble a stable hand type with high levels, repeatable card enhancements, and multiple compatible X Mult or retrigger effects.
Preserve the Jokers and modified cards that supply each multiplication layer through the late Antes.
Play the fully prepared hand and finish its scoring sequence at 100,000,000 Chips or more.

achievements.description: Thin your deck down to 20 or fewer cards
achievements.summary: Reduce the current deck to 20 or fewer playing cards during one standard run.

guide.context: The Hanged Man destroys up to two selected cards, while Immolate destroys five random cards in hand, making consumable generation the direct route to a small deck.

steps.text: Buy Arcana and Spectral Packs and take The Hanged Man or Immolate whenever the run can survive the loss of cards.
Use The Hanged Man on up to two selected cards and Immolate when its five random destructions are acceptable.
Check the deck viewer and continue permanent card destruction until 20 or fewer cards remain.

achievements.description: Have 80 or more cards in your deck
achievements.summary: Increase the current deck to 80 or more playing cards during one standard run.

guide.context: Standard Packs add purchased playing cards, while DNA and Cryptid can repeatedly copy valuable cards already in the deck.

steps.text: Open Standard Packs and add a playing card whenever the run's economy permits.
Use DNA's first single-card hand each round and copies of Cryptid to add permanent card copies.
Check the deck viewer and continue adding permanent cards until the deck contains at least 80.

achievements.description: Win a run without rerolling the shop
achievements.summary: Win a standard run without pressing @mechanic{Reroll} in any shop.

guide.context: Buying offered cards, packs, and Vouchers is allowed; only manually rerolling the shop invalidates the run.

steps.text: Start a standard run and commit to the first shop inventory shown after each Blind.
Never press the Reroll button, even when no useful purchase appears.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind and reach the You Win screen without any shop reroll.

achievements.description: Complete any challenge run
achievements.summary: Win any one of Balatro's 20 @mechanic{Challenge Deck} runs.

guide.context: Challenge Mode unlocks after standard-run wins with five different decks, and its first five challenges become available together.

steps.text: Win standard runs with five different decks to unlock Challenge Mode.
Open Challenge Mode from the deck selection screen and choose one of the first five Challenge Decks.
Meet that Challenge Deck's restrictions and defeat its Ante 8 Boss Blind.

achievements.description: Complete every challenge run
achievements.summary: Win all 20 @mechanic{Challenge Deck} runs in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Challenge Mode and its first five challenges unlock after standard-run wins with five different decks; later challenges appear after new Challenge Deck wins, and all use White Stake.

steps.text: Complete each of the first five available Challenge Decks.
Continue winning newly available Challenge Decks until all 20 challenge entries are visible.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind with every Challenge Deck until all 20 entries show completion.

achievements.description: Discover a Legendary Joker
achievements.summary: Use @item{The Soul} from a Tarot or Spectral Pack to create and discover a Legendary Joker.

guide.context: Legendary Jokers do not appear in the shop; The Soul occupies an eligible Tarot or Spectral Pack choice only 0.3% of the time.

steps.text: Build enough economy to open Tarot and Spectral Packs whenever they appear.
Inspect every choice in those packs until the rare The Soul card appears.
Keep an open Joker slot, choose The Soul, and create the Legendary Joker to record its discovery.

achievements.description: Discover every Planet card
achievements.summary: Obtain and discover all 12 @item{Planet Cards} on one achievement-enabled profile.

guide.context: Three secret Planet Cards become eligible only during a run after their matching secret poker hands—Five of a Kind, Flush House, and Flush Five—have been played.

steps.text: Buy or take each available Planet Card from shops, Celestial Packs, and other card-generation effects.
Play Five of a Kind, Flush House, and Flush Five in standard runs so their secret Planet Cards can appear during those runs.
Open Collection from the main menu and continue obtaining missing Planet Cards until all 12 are discovered.

achievements.description: Discover every Tarot card
achievements.summary: Obtain and discover all 22 @item{Tarot Cards} on one achievement-enabled profile.

guide.context: A collectible card is discovered when it is obtained from a shop, pack, seal, or generation effect; merely viewing a locked Collection entry is insufficient.

steps.text: Buy Arcana Packs and take Tarot Cards that remain undiscovered in the Collection.
Buy missing Tarot Cards from shops or obtain them through purple seals and Tarot-generating effects.
Check Collection and continue obtaining missing entries until all 22 Tarot Cards are discovered.

achievements.description: Discover every Spectral card
achievements.summary: Obtain and discover all 18 @item{Spectral Cards} on one achievement-enabled profile.

guide.context: Spectral discoveries include rare cards such as The Soul; Challenge Deck discoveries do not count toward Collection progress.

steps.text: Buy Spectral Packs and take cards that remain undiscovered in the Collection.
Use the Ghost Deck after it is unlocked to gain more access to Spectral Cards during standard runs.
Check Collection and continue obtaining missing entries until all 18 Spectral Cards are discovered.

achievements.description: Discover every Voucher
achievements.summary: Purchase and discover all 32 @item{Vouchers} on one achievement-enabled profile.

guide.context: The 32 Vouchers form 16 pairs; each upgraded Voucher must first be unlocked by its listed condition, then can appear only after its base Voucher is bought in the same run.

steps.text: Open Collection, inspect the four Voucher pages, and note each locked or undiscovered entry.
Complete every locked upgraded Voucher's displayed unlock condition on standard runs.
During later runs, buy a pair's base Voucher, then purchase its upgraded Voucher when it appears in a subsequent Ante shop.
Continue until Collection shows all 32 Vouchers as discovered.

achievements.description: Discover 100% of your collection
achievements.summary: Discover all 340 counted items in the @mechanic{Collection} on one achievement-enabled profile.

guide.context: The Collection tracks Jokers, decks, Vouchers, consumables, editions, booster packs, tags, and Boss Blinds; Challenge Deck finds do not count.

steps.text: Open Collection from the main menu or Options and inspect every page for locked or undiscovered entries.
Fulfill the condition printed on each locked Joker, deck, or upgraded Voucher so it becomes obtainable.
Obtain remaining cards and Vouchers, acquire missing tags and editions, open each booster type, and defeat missing Boss Blinds.
Do not use Profile > Unlock All, because confirming that option disables achievements for the profile.
Continue standard runs until Collection reports all 340 counted items discovered.

achievements.description: Win with every deck on Gold Stake difficulty
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{Gold Stake} with each of Balatro's 15 standard decks, then complete one additional standard run.

guide.context: Each deck has its own eight-stake ladder. A current trigger error delays the achievement after the fifteenth Gold Stake win until another non-Challenge run is won on any stake.

steps.text: Discover all 15 standard decks through Collection milestones and the deck- or stake-win requirements shown on locked decks.
With each deck, win every stake in sequence until Gold Stake is available for that deck.
Defeat the Ante 8 Boss Blind on Gold Stake with every one of the 15 standard decks.
After the final deck receives its Gold Stake sticker, win any standard non-Challenge run on any stake to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Earn a Gold Sticker on every Joker
achievements.summary: Hold each of the 150 Jokers through a @mechanic{Gold Stake} win to earn every Gold Sticker, then complete one additional standard run.

guide.context: Gold Stickers are applied at the You Win screen to Jokers still held after the Ante 8 Boss Blind; self-destroying Jokers must therefore survive through that screen.

steps.text: Enable Display Stake Sticker During Run and record the Joker names that still lack a Gold Sticker when they appear.
During Gold Stake runs, buy unstickered Jokers and keep as many as the winning build can carry through the Ante 8 Boss Blind.
Prioritize rare Jokers and acquire self-destroying Jokers as late as possible so they remain held at the You Win screen.
Open Tarot and Spectral Packs for The Soul; on a random Gold Stake seed, its first use selects a Legendary Joker still missing a Gold Sticker.
Repeat Gold Stake wins until all 150 Joker entries display Gold Stickers.
Win one standard non-Challenge run on any stake after the final Gold Sticker is applied to trigger the achievement.
